extracted.intended_audience: students and practitioners of arithmetic and geometry (merchants, accountants, surveyors)
extracted.subtask_description: A multi-part arithmetic/geometry handbook for practical and speculative use (merchant arithmetic, bookkeeping, algorithms, geometry and proportions). The page is a detailed table of contents describing definitions, algorithms, measurement methods, bookkeeping rules, coinage/exchange, and tables/indexing for practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prima parte principale — scope on numbers and basic algorithms
rubrics_metrics.description: 'prima parte principale... tratta de numeri in tutti i modi cfx ala pratica fempliciie fpeculatiua' — covers numbers in all practical and speculative ways, including operations, algorithms, and induced rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains that the first part treats numbers and arithmetic 'in tutti i modi' (practical and speculative), includes figuring, calculating, caratterù, partite, multiplicare, summare, sottrarre, radici; with new rules induced and many practical algorithms and demonstrations. Emphasises presentation so each person can undertake operations with great facility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seconda parte principale — mercantile operations, barter, and examples between merchants
rubrics_metrics.description: 'feconda parte principale contiene compagnie, fecondo ogni erigentia mercatefea... baratti... cambi' — contains mercantile companies, exchanges among merchants, barters, pledges and sample cases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides numerous concrete merchant examples (casi pegni, cambi, baratti) illustrated both for ordinary commerce and for algebraic/speculative treatment; practical merchant rules and tables for pricing, transport, measures, and local market practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Terza parte principale — bookkeeping and account-keeping methods
rubrics_metrics.description: 'ter^a parte principale contiene regole.modi.verfi.e vie Pi faperetenenr tutti conti e feri/pture pd co2po traf!cante... quaderno, gio2nale, memo2ialc' — rules and ways to keep all accounts and merchant books.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies how merchants should keep a quaderno and giornale with two lines (Debito and Credito), how to record carriage numbers and ledger postings, when to remake notebooks, and inclusion of summaries at the end of the tract. Explains format and cross-referencing between journal and ledger for practical accounting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quarta parte principale — coins, currencies and exchange rates
rubrics_metrics.description: 'quarta parte tutte ...perùmifuretemonete cdclor cogiiicualuteoe cambi reali e termini dì I02 ìfe per tutti luog!>i' — catalogues coins, minted values and exchange terms for many places.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains tables of real exchange rates (cambi), coin descriptions and characteristics per place, tariffs and norms used by traffickers; intended to let a merchant know which coins are 'buone o non' and how to convert/assess them in trade.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quinta parte principale — practical geometry: measuring areas, solids, and surfaces
rubrics_metrics.description: 'quinta psrte principale contiene tutti modi apartenéri a la p2atfca oe geometria... misure ... superfici ... quadrilateri, pentagone, ceragone, linee curvilinee e circulari' — geometric practice for measuring and computing areas and solids.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives methods, rules, instruments and algorithms for measuring planar figures and solids (barrels, casks, prisms, pyramids, cones, circular parts), including how to measure parts of circles, arcs, and how to compute volumes useful to merchants and artisans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitions and divisions of numbers (definitioni e divisione della quantità)
rubrics_metrics.description: 'bilfinicioni e DiuiOonc Oc la quantità oifcreta e continua' — formal definitions to distinguish discrete and continuous quantities and to classify numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes definitions of number types (integer, discrete vs continuous), how they are represented, and the division of articles into numbered parts; foundational vocabulary and distinctions used throughout the treatise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification of numbers: even/odd, prime/composite, aliquot parts
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries on 'numero primo e incomporto', 'parte aliquota e non aliquota', 'numero compofito' etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines prime, composite, aliquot (divisor) and non-aliquot parts; explains formation and classification rules for numbers and their consequences for further arithmetic and number theory sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Origin and creation of numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: 'belorigincecreationeoltralcdatede li numeri' — discussion of the origin/creation of numbers and their genesis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treats the conceptual genesis of numbers, historical/philological notes, and theoretical considerations about how numbers arise; used to motivate further classification and properties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Properties of even/odd numbers and related notable orders
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple articles on properties of 'numeri pariterpari' and 'numeri pariterìpari' and 'ordine mirabilissimo fra loro' — lists notable properties and relations among even and odd numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains theorems and notable properties (many specific properties enumerated) about parity, pairwise relationships, and arithmetic consequences for solving problems and constructing proofs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Square numbers: creation, properties and detection
rubrics_metrics.description: Many items: 'numeri quadrati... la loro ejcirtimatioiic', 'modo a cognofeae quafunclx numero quadrato' — treatment of square numbers and how to recognize/create them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes methods to generate square numbers, estimation and extraction techniques, demonstrative rules and algorithms to decide if a given number is a square and to construct square arrangements; related congruence considerations appear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Congruent numbers and congruences useful for square detection
rubrics_metrics.description: 'li numeri congrui e congruenti comodi a trouaré li numeri quadratùt' — on congruences and residues aiding square number detection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presents origin and formation rules for congruent numbers, modular considerations, and lemmas used to transform or recognize square numbers; includes general rules and worked examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Polygonal (figurate) numbers: pentagonal, heptagonal, etc.
rubrics_metrics.description: References to 'numero pétagonale e ... epta a gonale' and other polygonal figurate numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines polygonal numbers, how to form them and their uses, along with indications where practical examples are located ('non spetta ala p^acti'). Useful for theoretic enumeration and illustrative problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Algorithms of addition (algoritmo detta addinone)
rubrics_metrics.description: 'la feconda fpc del algoritmo detta addinone... cofa la fia e corno se la fia afare in tutte le fojti' — algorithm(s) of addition, ancient and modern.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives the algorithmic description of addition, both ancient and modern methods, examples and explanations covering positional and non-positional additions, carrying rules and notation conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Algorithms of subtraction (sottrarre) and complementary rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple items on subtraction: how to subtract in various modes, complements and borrowing rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains methods to perform subtraction across different numeral formats and contexts, including fractional subtractions and relations to addition; includes examples and demo proofs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Algorithms of multiplication — many modes and local variants
rubrics_metrics.description: 'quarta fpé de {alg02irmo ocf fa multiplcationc ... be molti modi uarij oiuerfi... commo ... in vinegia ... toscana ... castella' — numerous methods of multiplication used in practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerates multiple multiplication techniques (by lattice, by Venetian/Tofclana/Castellana commercial modes, by column, by folding, by tables), with practical notes on when each is convenient and sample computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Algorithms of division — practical dividing methods and rules
rubrics_metrics.description: 'quattro modo ... il algoritmo detta diuifideo uero pirc i quati modi ala p2actica vulgare' — division algorithms in practical use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes rule-based procedures for division (various practical methods), means to start, step rules, and tables for routine division; guidance on how to choose an appropriate method per context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operations on fractions ('rotti') — definitions and full suite of fraction arithmetic
rubrics_metrics.description: Large section on 'rotti' (fractions): definitions, making, summing, subtracting, multiplying, dividing, comparing, simplifying, converting between mixed/ improper forms, and example procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives definitions of fractions, many algorithms to operate with fractions (sumare rotti, sottrarrotti, moltiplicare rotti, dividere rotti), rules for converting units, procedures for complex fraction operations and many worked examples for merchant use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extraction of roots and approximation methods (square root, cube root, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Items such as 'modo a fapere trouare la quadra', 'modo a trouare le radici' and 'apjofimare le radici' — methods to extract roots and approximate them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presents algorithms to extract square and other roots, geometric and arithmetic approaches, approximation techniques and iterative procedures to obtain root values used both in pure and applied computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rules and theory of proportions and proportionality (simple and compound)
rubrics_metrics.description: Extensive section on 'proportioni e proportionalita' including simple, duplicate, triplicate, compound proportions and geometric/arithmetic proportions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines proportion types, how to form and manipulate proportions, mean proportional, insertion of terms, augmentation/decrement of terms, compound proportional problems and solution rules for proportion-related merchant and geometric problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tables, catalogs and ordering rules (taula / catayno)
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries on 'taula ordinarimente', 'catayno... come fare la faccia del catayno' — how to prepare and order tables and catalogues of the work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives rules for placing parts and entries in tables, how to make a catalog (catayno) with main positions, double positions, notes, and the harmony/consistence among the tables; includes instructions on ordering indices and cross-references for easy retrieval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measurement standards, units conversion and traveling/transport rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections on 'modo come le monete... regola... come si debia fare le ragidi o viaggi e transportati di robbe e monete di luogo a luogo' — rules for measuring and transporting goods, and for unit/coin conversions across places.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how to measure items for transport, limit and character of coin measures, practical adjustments when moving goods/monies between locations, tariffs, limits on gains and losses, and conversion methods between differing local measures and coinages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summaries and memory aids (breviario / sommario)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mentions 'Brboro e fumario oc tutte fpe oirmmert finora ditte ebe con breuira a memoria se pollino màdare' — concise summaries and aids to memory for the treatise content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies compilation of short summaries and memory-reducible indexes for each part and section so that practitioners can recall and apply the rules quickly; indicated placement at ends of tractates for quick reference.
